core_v1.scope: New geometry code/test objects plus reused qualified support archives; not a current integrated CFD binary or MPI lifecycle qualification.

core_v2.scope: New geometry code/test objects plus reused qualified support archives; not a current integrated CFD binary or MPI lifecycle qualification.

oracle.scope: New exact-parameter arithmetic at five scales and both edge/facet parameters; not a new mapped mesh, integration, transfer, MPI or restart acceptance.

compatibility.scope: Existing serial cancellation/subnormal/segment/saved-M6-midpoint controls only; no full CFD/integrated/MPI lifecycle qualification.

inverse_parameter_alias.interpretation: Coordinates do not uniquely encode the original parameter. This alone does NOT disprove a separately declared, deterministic canonical inverse geometry policy.

projection_recovery_loses_valid_paramete.scope: Local forward-geometry/positivity witness only; not a global embedding, quality, metric, or accepted CFD mesh certificate.
projection_recovery_loses_valid_paramete.review_correction: Use normal displacement epsilon/2; the review used epsilon, whose extra tangential error exceeds its claimed displacement bound.

implementation_decisions: Never round dependent barycentric coefficients before topology predicates.
Persist a parameter binding OR specify and certify a canonical inverse policy; distinguish these geometry models.
Retain the strict old case as negative evidence; map errors require explicit opt-in and original-source envelope admission.
limitations: Negative algebraic evidence only; not a complete mapped geometry, accepted mesh, transfer/restart or performance result.

unsupported: No runtime option activates mapped bodies.
Boundary parameter store/private proposals/atomic MPI publication and N-M return are not connected.
Finite symmetry-plane/line queries do not yet consume latent bindings.
No mapped parameter SU2/CGNS node-remap persistence or real restart.
All original facet edges remain protected; no general triangulation-seam removal.
No new complete accepted oblique/exterior/multiple-body mesh, 2D lifecycle, viscous or affordability result.
resource_scope: One nice19 compiler at a time; host available memory~40--41GiB. No whole-job peak RSS or complete-event timing measured. Support archive pinning and geometry preparation costs not separately timed.
